title: Construction of luminescent high-nuclearity Zn–Ln rectangular nanoclusters with flexible long-chain Schiff base ligands

synthesis.procedure: All reactions were performed under dry oxygen-free dinitrogen using standard Schlenk techniques. In the presence of Et3N (1.08 mmol; the SI text layer also shows a corrupted volume/concentration token), a mixture of H2L1 (0.4 mmol, 0.148 g), Zn(OAc)2·2H2O (0.4 mmol, 0.0878 g) and Sm(NO3)3·6H2O (0.4 mmol, 0.1778 g) in MeOH/EtOH (1:2, 15 mL) was stirred and heated under reflux for 10 minutes. The mixture was cooled and filtered. Diethyl ether was allowed to diffuse slowly into the filtrate at room temperature, giving pale yellow crystals after one week. The main text names the zinc salt as Zn(OAc)2·4H2O and gives no numerical amounts; the quantities above are from the SI.
synthesis.temperature: reflux, then room temperature for crystallization
synthesis.time: reflux 10 min; crystals after one week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk conditions under dry oxygen-free dinitrogen; reflux in MeOH/EtOH followed by diethyl ether diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled and filtered; slow diethyl ether diffusion into the filtrate at room temperature gave pale yellow crystals

properties.summary: In CH3CN and the amorphous solid, 1 shows ligand-sensitized Sm(III) visible and NIR emission. Visible Φem is 0.27% with τ = 25.24 μs and ηsens = 32.14%; NIR Φem is 0.14% with τ = 30.18 μs. Excitation while monitoring either the visible or NIR Sm emission gives a band near 405 nm, consistent with Zn/L-to-Sm energy transfer.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same SI procedure as 1 under dry oxygen-free dinitrogen, using H2L1, Et3N (1.08 mmol), Zn(OAc)2·2H2O (0.4 mmol, 0.0878 g) and Nd(NO3)3·6H2O (0.4 mmol, 0.1753 g) in MeOH/EtOH (1:2, 15 mL), refluxed for 10 minutes, filtered, and crystallized by slow diethyl ether diffusion. properties.summary: 2 shows NIR Nd(III) luminescence in CH3CN and the solid state, with bands near 872, 1065 and 1334 nm. In CH3CN, τ = 4.91 μs, Φem = 0.17% and ηsens = 8.67%. Excitation bands are near 285 and 370 nm, with the 370 nm band much stronger.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same SI procedure as 1 under dry oxygen-free dinitrogen, using Et3N (1.08 mmol), Zn(OAc)2·2H2O (0.4 mmol, 0.0878 g), Nd(NO3)3·6H2O (0.4 mmol, 0.1753 g) and H2L2 (0.4 mmol, 0.1481 g) in MeOH/EtOH (1:2, 15 mL). The mixture was refluxed for 10 minutes, cooled, filtered, and crystallized by slow diethyl ether diffusion. Yellow crystals formed after one week. The SI ligand preparation uses 2-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzaldehyde and diethylenetriamine, and the CCDC formula contains no Br, although the main text names H2L2 as the 5-bromo analogue. The main text gives no numerical amounts.
